messages:
maria.g: AuroraHW asked for a joint perf/W + throughput run on their new 48GB board. They want a reproducible how-to and a marketplace profile. Can we sketch scope?
jon.p: Proposal: Llama-2-70B + Llama-3-70B; precisions FP16, INT8; seq lengths 512/2048; batch sizes 1/4; report tokens/s, p95 latency, and joules/token.
kevin.l: Include GPU temps and sustained clock checks. Try stock kernels and Auroratuned kernels. Capture driver and runtime tags.
sara.t: I'll handle CI + runner image. Need a single entrypoint script that outputs CSV + telemetry JSON to s3.
alex.aurora: We'll provide 6 nodes and PDUs, plus our power collector CSVs and PDU mapping. We can also share kernel modules under NDA if needed.
maria.g: Publishing: 1) technical joint post focusing on methodology and tuning lessons, 2) marketplace tile with recommended config. Emphasize reproducibility and include run artifacts.
jon.p: Show single-card and 4-card scaling. Also cold-start vs warmed-KV comparisons.
kevin.l: I'll own ingestion + dashboard. Metric names: tokens_per_sec, joules_per_token, p95_ms, gpu_temp_c. Tag each run with container digest + commit.
sara.t: I'll publish a docker image redwood/bench:aurora-48gb and a GH Action that runs the sweep and uploads artifacts.
alex.aurora: Confirm nodes and access by Monday. On-call will be Aurora engops during runs.
benchbot: benchmark-runner: sanity job 11001 started at 1835298900 (llama-3-70b, seq=512, batch=1). Artifacts -> s3://redwood-bench/aurora-48gb/sanity/11001/
marketing.jess: Marketing will draft visuals for infra/platform engineers. Please add embargo dates to the repo checklist.
maria.g: I'll create bench/aurora-48gb-playbook repo and a publish checklist. Sync in #partnerships Monday 10am PT.
